issue.title: Isolated drawer annotation test fails on the Stale drawer expectation
issue.description: Observed at base SHA 478d5233100d45ba27d1bf29530eb790a36a8837 during just check: native::capture::block_diff::tests::annotate_drawer_lines_uses_after_snapshot_except_removed fails at src/native/capture/block_diff.rs:708 because the actual after-snapshot annotations omit the Stale drawer while the expected list includes it. An immediate isolated cargo test --lib rerun reproduced the identical left/right values. The implementation did not modify src/native/capture/block_diff.rs.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The test failed in the full workspace check and again immediately when run by itself on the same tree with the same missing Stale drawer annotation.

issue.creation_reason: The workspace just check failed this test, and an immediate isolated rerun produced the same assertion mismatch. The failure is in untouched block_diff code, so it is a confirmed unrelated CI failure to track separately.
